title: Controls turn-contract
description: The `controls[]` array a Chat V2 turn may carry alongside its prose, and the `controlAction` a client replies with. Generalizes the F9.1 resolveChoices/confirm-or-choose contract into typed, composable UI descriptors (I-3). Emitted in a deprecation window ALONGSIDE the legacy `resolveChoices`/`choices` (dual-emit) until the frontend migrates. Backend-authored and backend-consumed; the client renders controls and echoes a controlAction back, it never invents control ids.

value.description: Stable identifier echoed back in controlAction.value (userId, duty-station code, or enum value).

source.description: Typeahead data source for an autocomplete control — the I-6 directory endpoint.

directory.description: Directory kind; selects the endpoint path segment and the resolver.

endpoint.description: GET typeahead URL; the client appends `?q=` (and optional `&limit=`).

minChars.description: Minimum query length before the client calls the endpoint.

id.description: Unique within the turn. The client echoes it in controlAction.controlId.

type.description: confirm = a resolved default to accept or override (with optional alternatives + search child); choice = pick one of a closed option set (enum slot); autocomplete = typeahead against a directory source; date = a calendar picker for a date slot, the client returns an ISO 8601 date via a `date_select` action (TASK-PROMPT-001); multichoice = pick ANY NUMBER of a closed option set (an enum slot with `multi`, i.e. an Altiora checklist), committed as an array via `multichoice_select` (P1-13). (type:'text' is deferred — free-text still arrives via the plain `message`.)

defaultValue.description: For type=confirm: the pre-resolved value to accept on a bare confirm (object for user/location slots, scalar otherwise).

multi.description: For type=autocomplete: the field holds SEVERAL directory records, so the picker stays open and shows each pick as a chip. Altiora renders the same field as a MultiEmployeeSelector, which toggles a user in and out of an array; each pick still arrives as an ordinary `submit` and is APPENDED rather than replacing the last.

selected.description: For type=multichoice: option values already chosen, pre-checked in the client. For type=autocomplete with multi: the records already picked, as {value,label} so they can be rendered without a second lookup.

prefill.description: An optional value the client pre-fills. Convenience only — the committed value is always what the user submits. For type=date it must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); for text/textarea/number a string; for toggle a boolean.

placeholder.description: For the free-input controls (text/textarea/number): hint text shown inside the empty input.

rows.description: For type=textarea: initial visible row count.

fields.description: For type=cascade_confirm: the whole cluster of values one answer resolved (e.g. name/grade/duty station from an index number), shown as a single review. Display only — accepting re-resolves server-side rather than trusting these values back.

display.description: Resolved value as shown to the user.

options.description: Selectable options. Required for type=choice; the alternatives for type=confirm.

children.description: Nested controls revealed when the parent's value equals showChildrenOn — e.g. an autocomplete revealed under a confirm's `_search`, or under a 'for someone else' choice.

showChildrenOn.description: The parent value (an option value, or the sentinel `_search`) that reveals `children`. Advisory to the client; the backend still validates whatever controlAction comes back.

controlAction.description: A client's reply to a control. Rides the POST /chat body alongside (and taking precedence over) the legacy `choice`.

controlId.description: The control.id being answered (diagnostic; the backend keys on slotId).

action.description: confirm = accept the control's defaultValue; select = pick options[].value; search = re-resolve with `value` as the query; submit = commit an autocomplete pick (treated as select); date_select = commit a date control's picked ISO 8601 value (validated then treated as select); multichoice_select = commit a multichoice control's chosen option values, carried in `values` (P1-13); text_input = commit a text/textarea control's string (one action for both — they differ only in how they are rendered); number_input = commit a number control's numeric value; toggle_input = commit a toggle control's boolean (TASK-003/004); cascade_accept = accept a cascade_confirm cluster (the backend RE-RESOLVES and patches — the echoed values are never trusted); cascade_edit = decline the cluster and fill those fields by hand instead (P1-12); edit = the user clicked the ✎ button on a row of the confirm-form review to change that field — the backend steers the next turn onto `slotId` and asks for a new value (warning first if the field has filled cascade dependents). Not offered for reference-derived (directory/dictionary/LOV) values.

value.description: Option value / query string / picked item, per action. Omitted for a bare confirm.

values.description: For action=multichoice_select: the chosen option values. Every entry must be one of the control's options; the backend re-validates against the slot's presentOptions.
